business_problem: FPT Smart Cloud needed more natural, multilingual virtual assistants and more scalable employee upskilling systems, but high speech-synthesis training costs, long processing times, and the need for personalized knowledge delivery limited how far those AI services could scale.
solution_summary: FPT Smart Cloud built two NVIDIA-accelerated application stacks: FPT AI Engage for customer-service virtual assistants and FPT AI Mentor for workforce development. FPT AI Engage combines LLMs, NLP, ASR, and TTS with NVIDIA software pipelines to automate inbound and outbound calling, IVR, telesales, reminders, and FAQ resolution. The deployment uses NVIDIA GPU Operator and MIG support in Kubernetes for multi-tenant scale, then optimizes inference with NVIDIA TensorRT and NVIDIA Triton Inference Server using dynamic batching. For model training, FPT moved speech-synthesis and LLM workloads from A100-based systems to NVIDIA H100 and DGX H100 nodes, alongside NVIDIA NGC, PyTorch, and NVIDIA-powered RAG workflows. That stack lets FPT build more human-like voices in 18 languages, personalize microlearning through AI Mentor, generate situational Q&A from enterprise knowledge bases, and deliver both call-center automation and staff training from a common accelerated AI foundation.
